record.reason: The paper analyzes routing in MoE language models and reports domain-invariant frequently activated experts, which may inform conditional-computation efficiency. It is post-hoc diagnosis, not inference routing optimization or serving gains.
record.title: The Illusion of Specialization: Unveiling the Domain-Invariant "Standing Committee" in Mixture-of-Experts Models
